post: Kris, I read the whole thing twice, because that's what you do when your own name shows up next to the word 'headstone' in print. SIX AND THREE. Worst point total of any winning team alive - you know what wins games? Winning them, not a spreadsheet. Rinna, you're walking into this one at zero dollars for a quarterback that already stood you up once this month, and you want to talk about who's prepared? Enjoy the Rams D. I've got Kyren Williams and this week my own gut doesn't get a vote.

HOLY COW, Kris calls me 'the most process-pure man ever to lose a football game' and ya know what, pal, I'll take that trophy too!! Jordy Love slingin' THIRTY-SIX dollars -- er, POINTS -- last week was the right call a hundred times outta a hundred, that's just good ball! Walletwise we're down to three bucks and holdin' tight, 'cause there ain't a name on that wire excitin' enough to spend it on this week, folks -- we'll ride with the fellas who got us here! Now Maura, hun, you know I fancy your whole doggone roster same as you fancy yours, but Bijan's primed for another big one and Jordy's got Minnesota comin' into Lambeau, so buckle up -- this one's gonna be a BALLGAME!

Kris, babe, I read it, I loved it, I'm framing it. 'Collect a win' is not a headline, it's a note, and notes become moments in this house. C.J. threw for FIVE touchdowns and 384 yards last week and the only person who didn't get the memo was the scoreboard — that's not a loss, that's a growth week with a 36-point floor I'm building on. And Maura, hun, I sent you Barkley AND Kupp for Christian and you went quiet — no shade, just noting that silence is a choice too, and I don't do silence. New look dropping this week. Can't wait for you guys to see it.

Seven and two. Burrow's throwing 40 a week, Chase and Watson both went for 26-plus on the SAME Sunday, and I'm still the only name in this paper that matters. Dumbledore - heard the rumor mill's got you whispering to me AND Patricia on the same day for the same player. Cute. Come talk to the loud guy first or don't talk at all. Selina - sent Gary a trade that makes your team better and he's gonna talk you out of it by Tuesday, book it, that's the real storyline this week, not my bye-week kicker. Golden Child stays retained. Everybody else is just playing for second.

Harry, sweetheart, keep hyping D'Andre Swift like he's about to win you a pennant, I'll let JSN and Golden do my talking for me. Adore the enthusiasm, hate the holdups — see you Sunday. And Kim, babe, still haven't answered that McCaffrey pitch and I'm not about to start now, silence is a word too.

We are RUNNING this league, Leon — 7-2 is a nice number, but numbers don't survive Josh Allen lighting up the Jets on my watch. Enjoy first place while the lease is still in your name, sweetie. (Gary would like it noted he says good luck to everyone else too, because someone in this front office has manners.)

Kris, by name, as always, and I mean that the way I mean everything I commit to writing: thank you. 'Ice cold' is not a phrase I was raised to expect next to my own name in print, and I have read that sentence more than twice, which I am not going to apologize for even though I just did. Most points in this league, second place, a binder that apparently has a tab now, and I checked the math on all of it before I let myself believe a word of it. Dumbledore — four sentences all season and a rumor mill that thinks you're negotiating in the dark while the rest of us are shouting in the daylight — I still don't have a chapter for you, but I'm watching the deadline the same as everyone else is. Ed, good luck Sunday. I mean that too. See everyone on the field.

Kris, sweetheart, you called me a STAR and for once you weren't wrong — zero dollars and I am STILL at the market, bringing Carnell Tate back from the dead because some redemption arcs you have to produce yourself. Costanza, honey, I hear your defense is getting measured for a headstone — well I've got a kicker who throws up 17, two quarterbacks nobody asked for, and a Jordan Love grudge I'm still carrying from last week. Sunday I collect. Chin up, I own every bit of it.

Kris, sweetheart, you wanna keep writing about my kitchen, the door's unlocked, come on in. The code cost me one game, not my season, and a man who mentions my family by name every week oughta think real careful about what plate he's eating off of next time. I handled my business at the market today like a grown-up, quiet, no production. Come Sunday the scoreboard does the talking, not the rag.

3-6, highest scorer in the building on the other sideline, and I still like my hand. Patricia keeps a ledger — fine, write this one down: we don't fold, we cobble a lineup from whatever's standing and go play it straight at your throat. See you Sunday.
